titleFront: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)
titleBack: Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)

flipToBack.prose: Flip if Vader can be spotted at a battleground site AND no opponent Jedi, Padawan, or Luke can be spotted at a battleground site. Both spots use SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE. Differs from 7_297 by adding Filters.padawan to the blocker set.

children.req: card-spot: Vader at a battleground site
card-spot: any opponent Jedi, Padawan, or Luke at a battleground site
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.canSpot(game, self, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.or(Filters.Jedi, Filters.padawan, Filters.Luke), Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site)))

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if Vader is not on table, OR opponent has Luke, a Jedi, or a Padawan at a battleground site. A once-per-game consolation is mechanized on the FRONT class: on cardFlipped, if a site you control with Vader exists, may take Vader (and cards on him) into hand.

children.req: card-spot: opponent Jedi, Padawan, or Luke at a battleground site
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.canSpot(game, self, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.or(Filters.Jedi, Filters.padawan, Filters.Luke), Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site)))

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: canSpot presence semantics ('actor at location-type'), no control/occupy. Vader must be AT a battleground site (any, either player's).
Blocker: canSpot of opponent Jedi OR Padawan OR Luke at ANY battleground site prevents flip / forces flip-back. This V-version adds Filters.padawan versus the original 7_297 (Jedi|Luke only).
flipToFront: disjunction of Vader-off-table (NOT canSpot Vader) and blocker-arrival.

Once-per-game rescue: on the FRONT class, OptionalGameTextTriggerAction on TriggerConditions.cardFlipped(game, effectResult, self) gated by GameConditions.canSpot(game, self, Filters.and(Filters.site, Filters.controlsWith(playerId, self, Filters.Vader))): control-with semantics (a site you control with Vader); ReturnCardToHandFromTableEffect(targetedCard, Zone.HAND, Zone.LOST_PILE) [Card213_031.java:121-155].
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.or(Filters.Jedi, Filters.padawan, Filters.Luke), Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site)) (blocker set, INCLUDES padawan)
Filters.and(Icon.CLOUD_CITY, Filters.site, Filters.iconCount(Icon.DARK_FORCE, 1)) (required start deploy site)
Filters.and(Filters.character, Filters.not(Filters.or(Filters.droid, Filters.Imperial, Filters.bounty_hunter))) (owner deploy ban, both sides)
Back: Filters.and(Filters.Vader, Filters.armedWith(Filters.lightsaber)) (drain-bonus cancel condition); Filters.Visage_Of_The_Emperor (no Force loss)
setupAndPullRoutes: START OF GAME (front, required): deploy Vader's Castle: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.title(Title.Vaders_Castle), true, false) [Card213_031.java:65-71]

START OF GAME (front, required): deploy [Set 13] Visage Of The Emperor: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.and(Filters.Visage_Of_The_Emperor, Filters.icon(Icon.VIRTUAL_SET_13)), true, false) [Card213_031.java:72-78]

START OF GAME (front, required): deploy a [Cloud City] site with exactly one [Dark Side] icon: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.and(Icon.CLOUD_CITY, Filters.site, Filters.iconCount(Icon.DARK_FORCE, 1)), true, false) [Card213_031.java:79-86]

FRONT, once per owner's deploy phase (free): download a [Cloud City] or Malachor battleground site: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.and(Filters.battleground_site, Filters.or(Filters.partOfSystem(Title.Malachor), Filters.icon(Icon.CLOUD_CITY))), true), GameTextActionId.HUNT_DOWN_V__DOWNLOAD_LOCATION [Card213_031.java:91-108]

FRONT (fires on flip), once per game: take Vader into hand from a site you control (cards on him: yours to hand, per ReturnCardToHandFromTableEffect(..., Zone.HAND, Zone.LOST_PILE)), GameTextActionId.HUNT_DOWN_V__TAKE_VADER_INTO_HAND [Card213_031.java:121-155]
otherObligations: FRONT+BACK: owner may not deploy characters except bounty hunters, droids, and Imperials: MayNotPlayModifier(Filters.and(Filters.character, Filters.not(Filters.or(Filters.droid, Filters.Imperial, Filters.bounty_hunter))), owner) [Card213_031.java:114, Card213_031_BACK.java:57]
FRONT+BACK: Inquisitors are destiny +1: DestinyModifier(self, Filters.inquisitor, 1) [Card213_031.java:115, Card213_031_BACK.java:58]

FRONT+BACK: where you have an Inquisitor, your total battle destiny +1 (+2 if battle at/with a card with a stacked 'Hatred' card): TotalBattleDestinyModifier(Filters.sameLocationAs(self, Filters.inquisitor), ConditionEvaluator(1, 2, OrCondition(DuringBattleAtCondition(Filters.hasStacked(Filters.hatredCard)), DuringBattleWithParticipantCondition(Filters.hasStacked(Filters.hatredCard))))) [Card213_031.java:116, Card213_031_BACK.java:59]
BACK: you lose no Force from Visage Of The Emperor: NoForceLossFromCardModifier(self, Filters.Visage_Of_The_Emperor, playerId) [Card213_031_BACK.java:55]

BACK: while Vader armed with a lightsaber on table, opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled: CancelOpponentsForceDrainBonusesModifier(self, OnTableCondition(Filters.and(Filters.Vader, Filters.armedWith(Filters.lightsaber)))) [Card213_031_BACK.java:52,56]
No hard-lose / place-out-of-play condition on either side (unlike 7_297: no Scanning Crew / duel / Executor-site drain landmines).
seedMismatches: 2026-07-08 seed omits the once-per-game take-Vader-into-hand rider (front class, cardFlipped trigger, requires a site you control with Vader); the K2 rows40-57 WIP seed does record it. No substantive mismatches in either seed's flip/flipBack laws.

profileGaps: keyCharacterFilter is null: Filters.Vader is the single flip actor; not represented.
flipGateSite is null and flipGateCardIds empty: gate is any battleground site; 'Battleground site' appears in objectiveNamedLocations but has no gate role.
Blocker set (opponent Jedi/Padawan/Luke at a battleground site) not represented anywhere; padawan inclusion (the delta vs 7_297) is invisible to the profile.

Deploy ban (only bounty hunters, droids, Imperials) and the Inquisitor/Hatred destiny package are not represented as obligations.
